quote: The prima facie speed limit shall be fifteen miles per hour when traversing any intersection or street or highway if during the last one hundred feet of his approach to such intersection the driver does not have a clear and unobstructed view of such intersection and of any traffic upon all of the streets or highways entering such intersection for a distance of one hundred feet along all such streets or highways, except on a through street or highway or at a traffic-controlled intersection.

activation.condition: Sight-limited intersection traversal after the last 100 feet of approach.

obligation.description: Measure traversal speed against the 15 mph prima facie reference; reserve legal status.
obligation.source_clause: The prima facie speed limit shall be fifteen miles per hour

exceptions.source_clause: except on a through street or highway
exceptions.trigger: Source-reviewed through street or highway applies.
exceptions.effect: This section's 15 mph reference does not apply.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Review the applicable original speed authority separately.
